sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: The 📊 unique-values dropdown for a "Time" column (events listings) now offers a "Time info - Time of day" section with five fixed buckets — Morning (04:00-11:59), Lunch (12:00-12:59), Afternoon (13:00-17:59), Evening (18:00-23:59) and Night (00:00-03:59) — `_findCellTimeBucket()`.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: "Attributes - Identifier type" now also lists the parts of a slash-separated identifier type separately: a `BUMA/STEMRA ID` badge is offered as `BUMA/STEMRA ID`, `BUMA` and `STEMRA ID` — `_workAttrTypeLabels()`.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: The 📊 dropdown for a "Length" column now offers a "Length info - Milliseconds" section: "ms ≠ .000", "ms = .000" and "no ms data". Shown only once at least one cell carries milliseconds (after ⏱) — `_findCellLengthMsState()`.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: The 📊 dropdown for a "Relationship types" column now offers a "Relationship types - Credited as" section listing each `(as “credit”)` separately, prefixed with its relationship type (e.g. "» instrument as: lead guitar") — `_findCellRelTypeCredits()`.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: The 📊 dropdown for a "Tracks" column now offers a "Tracks info - Total" section with the summed track count over all mediums (the same number as the synthetic "Total Tracks" column), e.g. "5 + 5 + 5" → 15.
